title: [Main][all-e]Prepayment Invoice and Quantity Change Issue in Business Central
summary: Fixed an issue where prepayment invoices were not handled correctly when purchase or sales line quantities were changed, with updates applied across all localizations and new test cases added.
key_points: Bug fix for prepayment invoice handling with quantity changes
Updates to Purchase Line and Sales Line tables across all localization layers
New test cases added for prepayment scenarios
Changes applied consistently to both purchase and sales documents
Covers APAC, BE, CH, DACH, ES, FI, GB, IT, NA, NL, NO, RU, SE, and W1 localizations
